title: Matthew Thomson, National Jazz Awards finalist
excerpt: Former JazzRoc student Matthew Thomson was named a 2021 National Jazz Awards finalist for piano.
body:
We are proud to share that Matthew Thomson, who began his jazz journey with Captain Roc, was a finalist for piano in the 2021 National Jazz Awards.

Matthew went on to complete a masters at the Sydney Conservatorium of Music and to study at the New England Conservatory in Boston.

Every student starts at Module One. Matthew is proof of where the voyage can lead.
